item.tib: bla chen dran pa gsang bsgrub 'phrul gyi me long
item.coloph: de ltar bla chen gsang ba'i dril bsgrubs (sgrub) thugs sgrubs (sgrub) gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba phyi rabs 'gro ba rnams kyi don ched du/ gau sla khyer bde man ngag don 'dus yin/ phyi rab (rabs) rnal 'byor blo chung don ched du/ lta ba mdo bsdus bsgom pa'i man ngag snyed (rnyed/)'bras bu sangs rgyas dgongs pa mthong ba'i phyir/ thugs kyi bsgrub (sgrub) pa dmar byang 'di nyid bsgrub/ bla chen bdag zhal mthong ba the tshom med/ phyi rab (rabs) dus mtha'i rnal 'byor spyod yul mdzod/ yum chen mkha' 'gro'i gnyer gtad thub par gyis/ ces gsungs nas man ngag bka'i gnyer gtad mdzad/ slob dpon chen po b+he ro tsa na dang / stang chen dmu tsha 'od ldan 'bar mas/ shin tu zab par gzig (gzigs) nas thugs la sbas/ des nas dus dang las kyi dbang bsgyur nas/ gnas mchog dam pa shel le rdzong drug du/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor bdag la bsnyan (snyan) du brgyud/ bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya thub par bya (byas)/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chags yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ bla ma yab yum sku la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyong srung ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob par shog yum cig mkha' 'gro srid pa'i rgyal mo'i (mos/)phyi rab (rabs) las ldan gshen la brgyud pa dge legs 'phel//
